ConnectionStrings._comment: Live production DB — same as the API / AwardsAutoCalcWorker. Uses localhost because the worker runs ON the server. For local testing, point it at the remote host (Server=localhost;...).

Firebase._comment: Same Firebase service-account JSON the API uses. Deploy it next to the worker exe (ServiceAccountPath is relative to the exe dir) or set ServiceAccountAbsolutePath. If the file is missing, greeting push is disabled and email still sends.

Greetings._comment: The Default* text is used only when a club/district has not configured its own greeting text/subject.
Greetings.DefaultBirthdayMessage:
Wishing you a very happy birthday! 🎉

As you celebrate another year of togetherness, may your kindness continue to reach further and touch many lives.
Celebrate this special day by spreading hope through The Rotary Foundation.

🎁 Donate: https://my.rotary.org/en/donate
Greetings.DefaultAnniversaryMessage:
Warm wishes on your anniversary. 💐
As your hearts grow together, may your kindness reach further and continue to spread hope through The Rotary Foundation.

🎁 Donate: https://my.rotary.org/en/donate

Brand._comment: ROW instance brand (Services/Brand.cs). Same keys as the NestJS edition. Deployment values: set per server, e.g. Brand__Domains__AdminOrigin, Brand__Support__Phones__0.
